title: Niko's Create
description: This is the official Niko's Nook Discord modpack for our create-focused server!
body:
# The official modpack for the Niko's Nook SMP Discord server!

This pack is built for NeoForge 1.21.1 and is focused around mainly Create and Farmer's Delight. But it also contains many of the following:
- exploration mods!
- food and farming mods!
- decorative mods!
- custom worldgen mods!
- qol and performance!

To join, you’ll need to be in the Niko's Nook Discord and apply to be whitelisted there.
